shots.visual: Extreme close-up of Liu Bei's eye. The pupil dilates sharply. Reflected in the eye is a massive wave of brown floodwater crashing down like a dragon. The lighting is harsh and chaotic.
Liu Bei stands on a muddy ridge, water swirling at his boots. He looks down with a cold, indifferent expression. Rain mixes with the flood mist.
Zhuge Liang stares at Liu Bei, holding his feather fan tightly. His face shows shock and confusion at the sudden change in strategy. Sweat drips from his chin.
Liu Bei turns his head slowly, ignoring Zhuge Liang's concern. He gestures sharply with his sword hand, pointing towards the high ground.
Wide shot of the battlefield. Shu troops are retreating in an orderly but hurried manner towards the elevated terrain. The floodwater is advancing rapidly behind them, churning the ground.
Sun Quan grips the railing of his flagship, knuckles white. He looks relieved for a moment, believing he has saved his water fleet from the flood's direct impact.
Sun Quan's smile fades as he sees the water level rising rapidly around his smaller boats. The current is pulling his ships towards a dead-end bay.
Liu Bei stands atop the high rock, cold wind blowing his robe. He watches the floods converge, a slight, chilling smirk on his lips.
The massive wall of floodwater crashes into the bay where the Wu fleet is trapped. Explosions of wood and splintering masts fill the screen. Chaos erupts among the sailors.
Sun Quan is thrown off balance, his face distorted with terror. His flagship is tilting dangerously. Water splashes directly onto his face.
The flagship breaks in two. It sinks into the murky floodwater. Debris floats everywhere. The Wu water fleet is completely destroyed.
Liu Bei watches the destruction with a calm gaze. He sheathes his sword slowly. The rain begins to lighten.
Zhuge Liang looks at Liu Bei, his eyes wide with awe and fear. He realizes the scale of Liu Bei's ruthlessness and foresight.
